moments.title: Marc Anthony's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning Latin superstar Marc Anthony turns 58 today, known for hits like 'Vivir Mi Vida' and his iconic salsa style.

angles.name: Salsa King
angles.copy: Happy 58th birthday to the one and only Marc Anthony! What's your favourite track from the King of Salsa?

angles.name: Timeless Ballads
angles.copy: From 'I Need to Know' to 'Vivir Mi Vida', Marc Anthony's voice is pure gold. Celebrating his 58th today!

moments.title: Anastacia's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: The 'I'm Outta Love' powerhouse vocalist Anastacia celebrates her 58th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Powerhouse Vocals
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Anastacia turns 58! Get ready to belt out 'Left Outside Alone' with us. What's your top Anastacia track?

angles.name: Still Got The Moves
angles.copy: 58 and still rockin' it! Sending early birthday wishes to the incredible Anastacia for tomorrow.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 5 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns this weekend with Matchweek 5, featuring big clashes including Brentford vs Chelsea on Friday and Fulham vs Man Utd on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 5 is here! Who are you backing this weekend? Brentford vs Chelsea kicks us off Friday night.

angles.name: Big Sunday Games
angles.copy: Sunday's Premier League action includes Brighton vs Arsenal and Fulham vs Man Utd. Which game are you most excited for?

moments.title: Cosmic Void Festival London
moments.blurb: London's Cosmic Void Festival, celebrating metal and dark music, runs from Friday 18th to Sunday 20th September.

angles.name: Metal Weekend
angles.copy: Calling all metalheads! Cosmic Void Festival takes over London this weekend (Sept 18-20). Who's heading down for some dark tunes?

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: Looking for a heavy weekend? Cosmic Void Festival is live in London from Friday. Get your mosh on!

moments.title: Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey Live at The O2
moments.blurb: Tom Bailey of Thompson Twins brings his 'Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey' show to London's O2 Arena this Saturday, September 19.

angles.name: 80s Throwback
angles.copy: Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey is at The O2 this Saturday! Get ready for a massive 80s throwback. What's your favourite Thompson Twins hit?

angles.name: Live in London
angles.copy: Still got your tickets for Tom Bailey at The O2 on Saturday? We're buzzing for some classic 80s synth-pop live!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launch
moments.blurb: The pre-recorded launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 airs this Saturday, September 19, at 7:25 PM on BBC One, introducing this year's celebrity pairings.

angles.name: Strictly's Back!
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter and glamour! The Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch show is this Saturday at 7:25 PM on BBC One. Who are you hoping to see paired up?

angles.name: Celebrity Reveals
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! Strictly's launch show on Saturday reveals the celebrity pairings. We can't wait to see the new dancing duos!

moments.title: Liam Gallagher's 54th Birthday
moments.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher turns 54 on Monday, September 21.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher on Monday! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo hit?

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Still got that iconic swagger. Sending early birthday love to Liam Gallagher for Monday! Live Forever, indeed.

moments.title: Jason Derulo's 37th Birthday
moments.blurb: Chart-topping singer, songwriter, and dancer Jason Derulo celebrates his 37th birthday on Monday, September 21.

angles.name: Pop & Dance King
angles.copy: Talk about a hit machine! Jason Derulo turns 37 on Monday. What's your go-to track for getting on the dance floor?

angles.name: Derulo Day
angles.copy: Future sounds and TikTok trends, Jason Derulo keeps delivering! Wishing him a happy 37th for Monday.

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Series 17 Premiere
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22, at 8 PM on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Get your ovens preheated! The Great British Bake Off Series 17 starts Tuesday at 8 PM on Channel 4. And welcome to new judge Nigella Lawson!

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: It's official: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent! Tune in Tuesday at 8 PM for the premiere.

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox 2026
moments.blurb: The astronomical start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, the Autumnal Equinox, occurs on Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Hello Autumn!
angles.copy: Break out the pumpkin spice! The Autumnal Equinox marks the official start of autumn this Tuesday, September 22. What's your favourite thing about fall?

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: Longer nights and falling leaves are on the way! The Autumnal Equinox arrives on Tuesday, bringing astronomical autumn to the UK.

moments.title: Joan Jett's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Rock and Roll Hall of Famer and 'I Love Rock 'n' Roll' icon Joan Jett turns 68 on Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Rock Goddess
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the legendary Joan Jett on Tuesday! What's your favourite track from the queen of rock 'n' roll?

angles.name: Iconic Anthems
angles.copy: She loves rock 'n' roll, and so do we! Celebrating Joan Jett's 68th birthday this Tuesday. Play us some Jett!

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen's 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Boss, legendary rock icon Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen on Wednesday! What's your all-time favourite song from The Boss?

angles.name: Born To Run
angles.copy: 77 years young and still rockin'! Sending early birthday wishes to the legendary Bruce Springsteen for Wednesday.

moments.title: F1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix Weekend
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend begins Thursday, September 24, in Baku, with the race taking place on Saturday, September 26.

angles.name: F1 Race Weekend
angles.copy: Lights out and away we go! The F1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend starts Thursday, with a rare Saturday race on Sept 26. Who's your pick for the win?

angles.name: Baku Showdown
angles.copy: It's a Saturday race in Baku this weekend for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix! Practice and qualifying kick off Thursday. Get ready for some street circuit drama.
